newsitem.title: USA: KLLM Transport Q1 hurt by insurance costs.
newsitem.headline: KLLM Transport Q1 hurt by insurance costs.

text.p: KLLM Transport Services Inc President and Chief Executive Officer, Steven Bevilaqua, said the first quarter ended April 4 would have been profitable, except for higher than normal insurance costs.
The company reported a net loss for the quarter of $455,000, or $0.10 per share, as compared with a loss of $386,000, or $0.09 per share, in 1996.
Bevilaqua said the increased insurance costs related to both past and current claims.

He said that "over the past several months, we have reassessed our reserving and claims management practices. As a result, we have cleaned up a number of old claims, adopted a more conservative approach in reserving for claims and become more aggressive in claims management."

Bevilaqua concluded that although "we are clearly disappointed in the net results for the first quarter, we are pleased with our achievements in reducing costs and improving utilization. We also are encouraged by recent successes in
winning new business and increasing market share."
KLLM Transport Services is an irregular-route truckload carrier that specializes in temperature-controlled transportation.
